resources.string: The services this tool asks, in order. Drag a provider to move it, switch one off to skip it, or add your own server. Some providers can be added twice, with a second key or account. A provider that cannot be reached is skipped for a minute, so the next one answers at once.

GIFs and stickers keep separate lists but share keys: a KLIPY or GIPHY key set up on one page works on the other. GIPHY never shares a grid with another provider, because its terms do not allow it. The content filter below applies to KLIPY and GIPHY.

The services that translate, in order. The first one that answers is used, and if it fails the next one is asked. A provider that is off is never asked, so your text goes only to the ones that are on. The engine above decides which part of the list is used: On device asks only the phone, Online only the services, Automatic the whole list.
DeepL Write rewrites text in the grammar panel and the selection bar. It uses the DeepL key from the provider list above, so add DeepL there first. Write needs an API Pro key.

When you add a word that no vocabulary pack knows, the tool looks it up online to fill in the meaning, the examples and the pronunciation. It asks these services in order, and the next one only if the first has nothing.

Web search and image search share this list. The first provider that answers is used, and if it fails the next one is asked. A SearXNG instance must allow JSON results. Tavily and Brave need an API key, unless this build has a Brave key.
